items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: James A. Bland's material had to be in his repertoire.

ctx.x: For everybody. And then, years later, it was actually published and somebody took writer's credit for it. Yeah.

Certainly, uh, uh, James A. Bland's material had to be in his repertoire. Uh-huh. You know, like, uh... What songs? Oh Them Golden Slippers. Yeah. And, uh, In the Evening by the Moonlight. Mm-hmm. Those things had to be.
Now, was Louie playing, and of course, obviously, I mean, this may be an obvious question, was he playing when he worked in New Orleans? Did he work for both black and white audiences?
